name: p2-2025-sum-before-rate
title: Summing counters before rate hides the restart
spec: Two side-by-side panels with green headings. Left panel 'Wrong: sum first, then rate': two counter lines for pod A and pod B over time, with pod A dropping from 100 to 0 at a restart and pod B climbing by 100. The two lines are added into one flat total line, labelled 'Sum stays flat: the reset is invisible'. Orange outline on the flat total line with the note 'The work pod A did before the restart is lost'. Right panel 'Right: rate per series, then sum by the labels you keep': the same two counter lines each with a rate step, then a sum box labelled 'sum by the labels you keep', then a green result line labelled 'Fleet rate, reset handled per pod'. Bottom formula strip in monospace: 'sum by (labels you keep) (rate(counter))' and a note 'Rate per series, sum by the labels you want to keep, then divide.' A small note on the ratio: 'Numerator and denominator summed separately, then divided. Never average ratios.'
alt: Summing two pods' counters before the rate hides a restart, while taking the rate per series first keeps the reset visible and gives the fleet rate.
cap: Summing counters before taking the rate hides a pod restart, so the rate is taken per series first and then summed by the labels kept.

name: p2-2025-le-buckets
title: Histogram buckets: keep le, then take the quantile once
spec: Left: a histogram drawn as a row of cumulative boxes, each box labelled with an upper bound 'le' and a count, with the counts rising from left to right. A note 'Each box counts every request at or under its bound: cumulative'. An orange outline on the box where the target quantile falls. Middle: an arrow labelled 'histogram_quantile interpolates inside the bucket that holds the quantile'. Right: a two-row comparison. Row 1 'Trap: sum by (model) drops le' with a red cross and the note 'Breaks histogram_quantile'. Row 2 'Right: sum by (le, model)' with a green check and the note 'Keep le in the by clause, then take the quantile once'. Below the rows a flow of two pods' buckets: 'Pod A buckets' and 'Pod B buckets' joined to 'rate per series', then 'sum by (le, model)', then 'histogram_quantile(0.99)'. Caption: 'le stands for less than or equal to.'
anchor: ### 4. Histograms: keep le, then take the quantile once
alt: A cumulative latency histogram where summing without the le label breaks the p99, and the right query keeps le in the by clause before taking the quantile once.
cap: A latency histogram stores cumulative buckets by le, and the p99 is correct only when le stays in the by clause before histogram_quantile runs.
